name: 12-static-night-null
incident: the null hypothesis (added 2026-08-16 after min_smooth_since_probe shipped broken)
description:
Nothing happens. A genuinely dark room, gain flat at 3500 all night, day pipeline flat at 8000, realistic stochastic AGC noise, the real 3600s night_reconfirm_s, four hours of it. The assertion is a CLICK FLOOR: unchanged evidence must not buy a probe.

Every other scenario in this corpus asserts that CHANGED evidence is eventually acted on. Not one of them asserted the converse, and that gap is not theoretical - it shipped. min_smooth_since_probe (35af4c9) was a plain running minimum of the smoothed gain, which is an order statistic: its expected depth grows without bound in the number of samples, so on a perfectly static scene it descends until it crosses the 0.97 anchor bar and suspends the backoff. The number of samples is set by the reconfirm interval, which is exactly what the backoff lengthens, so the error is self-reinforcing in the wrong direction - longer backoff, more samples, deeper minimum, suspension fires, backoff defeated. On a static 3500 scene that is an audible IR-cut probe every hour, all night, on a camera watching a dark room where nothing has changed. The log lines it emits while doing it are structurally identical to the ones scenario 10 asserts as proof the fix WORKS.

Why the corpus reported eleven green scenarios throughout: noise_factor() was a bounded sum of two sinusoids. A deterministic periodic signal has a fixed, finite set of extremes, so any running minimum over it converges after one period and then stops moving - the failure mode is structurally inexpressible, at any noise_pct, for any duration. The noise model is stochastic as of the same commit as this scenario, which is the actual precondition for this file being worth anything.

WHAT IT ASSERTS, and why each one. max_switches=4 is the point: night entry plus the one reconfirm probe that always fires first in a session, and then nothing, because the skip gate should keep skipping a scene that has not changed. The forbid_log is sharper still - on a static scene the trend suspension must NEVER fire, so the absence of that line is the direct statement of the property, independent of how the click budget happens to round. Pre-fix this run produces 7 switches and the suspension line every hour; post-fix, 3 and never.

Keep this scenario slow and boring. It is the only one that fails when the machine becomes too eager rather than too sluggish, and every fix in this subsystem's record pushes on eagerness. If it ever needs its budget raised, that is the finding, not the fix.
